title: Preservation of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Forts & Maratha Military Landscapes
prelims_pointers: Maratha Military Landscapes nominated for UNESCO World Heritage status.
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) oversees national fortress restoration.

mains_perspective.context: Strategic conservation of 17th-century coastal and hill fortresses.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Balancing heritage tourism with environmental preservation.

title: Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture & Agriculture Policy Directions

Focuses on policy frameworks for sustainable agricultural growth.

mains_perspective.context: Evaluating structural reforms in agricultural supply chains.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Transitioning towards high-value agriculture and micro-irrigation.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure and Sovereign AI Stack Integration
prelims_pointers: India Stack includes Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker as open APIs.
MeitY acts as nodal agency for National AI Mission.

mains_perspective.key_arguments: Democratizes access while building domestic AI compute capacity.

title: Ethical Frameworks in Public Administration and Probity in Governance
prelims_pointers: Code of Conduct guidelines emphasize neutrality and integrity.
